display.purpose: Hero introduction and top-level section titles.

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: Ease the layered hero image reveal.

motion.name: technology-loop
motion.purpose: Move the technology strip continuously; pause on request and disable under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action for the main next step.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--white, #f4f4f1); color: var(--black, #090909); border: 1px solid var(--white, #f4f4f1); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.8rem 1.15rem; min-height: 48px; font: 700 0.9rem Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #d0d0cc; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #090909; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action over a dark surface.
components.css: .ds-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--white, #f4f4f1); border: 1px solid #d5d5d1; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0.8rem 1.15rem; min-height: 48px; font: 700 0.9rem Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--white, #f4f4f1); color: var(--black, #090909); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f1; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Centered Navigation
components.description: Centered links on the neutral header, with a center-out hover underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; color: var(--line, #383836); padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; font: 700 0.88rem Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav::after { position: absolute; right: 0.8rem; bottom: 0.4rem; left: 0.8rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: center; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #090909; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Surface
components.description: Flat monochrome frame for each project preview.
components.css: .ds-project { background: var(--bg-raised, #141414); color: var(--text, #f0f0ee); padding: 1.25rem; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 220ms ease; } .ds-project:hover { background: var(--surface, #1b1b1b); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-project:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f4f1; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio pairs the user's samurai artwork with a quiet, high-contrast field of black, white, and gray. The work and supplied images lead; the interface stays restrained so the art, projects, and contact paths remain easy to find.

The former sea-colored identity is replaced by monochrome surfaces and one deliberate image reveal. The supplied about-me image becomes the full-width background for the technology strip, which begins directly below the hero. Use the supplied artwork rather than adding decorative cultural symbols or inventing new brand marks.
keyCharacteristics: Black grounds with soft white-gray type.
The user's supplied artwork is the signature visual.
Flat surfaces, thin rules, and deliberate interaction.

rules.name: Monochrome Ground
rules.body: Keep the palette achromatic; use tonal contrast rather than a new accent color.

dos: Do keep the user-provided monochrome samurai and about artwork as the primary imagery.
Do preserve centered navigation and clear contact paths.
Do provide a non-hover control for image reveal and a pause control for the moving technology list.
donts: Don't reintroduce the previous sea palette.
Don't convert the existing raster logo to SVG by changing its file format; use a genuine vector source or a transparency-ready asset if one becomes available.
Don't add decorative cultural symbols that are not part of the user's supplied artwork.
